args.summary: 西红柿炒蛋 is plated, following Wang Gang's phases in order. (1) Heated the wok with oil to oil it up, then poured the oil out into the oil cup. (2) Took the heat off and poured in the 150 g of beaten egg at about 120 °C. Fried it on low heat (0.3) for about 1 min until it set, flipped it, fried the other side, then tipped it into the holding bowl. (3) Added 300 g of tomato wedges and stir-fried on low heat, then added 5 g of ketchup from the drum. (4) Added 60 g of water and simmered about 1 min at medium heat while stirring. (5) Added 30 g of starch water to thicken the sauce, then splashed in 5 g of finishing oil (明油). (6) Took the heat off, put the egg back, stirred 3 strokes and plated. The highest temperature was 152 °C and the smoke detector and stove guard never triggered. Differences from his video: the 1 g white vinegar was skipped as planned, and the 1 g salt and 1 g sugar were never added. Water and starch water amounts were my own choice.

decision.expect: The run ends with the dish plated and the wok clean and back on the cooker.
